decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's established laser coding expertise, and in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the multi-model line.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits close to the firm's core inkjet knowledge, has a dedicated web page, and supports the consumables business, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and improve it.
The piezo inkjet printer extends the firm's existing inkjet competence, which in-house development and production help it absorb, and it fits the Industry 4.0 traceability direction.
